pairs.l: 1 — I've broken your new iPad. I can't afford to have it fixed. I feel terrible.
2 — We all make mistakes. Just apologise, learn from it and move on.
3 — Stay in bed and take aspirins and vitamins regularly. You should feel better soon.
4 — Handling this machine is risky. Read the instructions and wear all protective gear.
5 — Moving out of your comfort zone requires courage. Playing it safe is not how you achieve great things.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (slomio/la je iPad, osjeća se strašno) = E (I am so sorry). Poruka 2 (svi griješimo, ne muči se) = A (Don't feel bad). Poruka 3 (ostani u krevetu, pij aspirin) = F (Take care of yourself). Poruka 4 (pazi s mašinom, nosi opremu) = B (Be careful). Poruka 5 (izađi iz zone komfora, preuzmi rizik) = D (Take the risk).

r6.exp: 'Someone can drive me to YOUR PLACE' → Zaynova zabava je kod njega doma = C (At his home).

r7.exp: 'An hour to get TO AND FROM' = sat ukupno, dakle 30 minuta za dolazak (A = Thirty minutes).

r8.exp: 'Side with the critics' koji su rekli 'dull' = dosadan → Hailey je zaključila da je film bio dosadan = A (boring).

r9.exp: Početak u 9:00, Charli dolazi 15 minuta ranije → 9:00 − 0:15 = 8:45 (B).

r10.exp: Glavni razlog putovanja je 'university tour' u Oxfordu (u subotu) → C (To look around a university in Oxford).

r11.exp: Naručeno 1826., završeno 5 godina NAKON vjenčanja 1831. → 1831 + 5 = 1836 = C.

r12.exp: 'Construction was CARRIED OUT by John Platt' = gradnju je izveo John Platt = A.

r13.exp: Epwick je 'the first' = 10 minuta, Bailden je 'the second' = 20 minuta → Epwick je najbliži = A.

r14.exp: 'Heyside Hall shows the NEO-GOTHIC style' = B.

r15.exp: George III izbrojao 550 (Longside Palace), Heyside ima 20 više → 550 + 20 = 570 = B.

r16.exp: 'They're able to (16)____, seeing incredible places' → F: work when and where they want to. Sloboda rada = pravo mjesto i pravo vrijeme.

r17.exp: 'As a result of the pandemic, (17)____' → E: remote work has become a reality. Pandemija je ubrzala prihvaćanje rada na daljinu.

r18.exp: 'Use technology (18)____. These are coffee shops, co-working spaces...' → C: to work in different places. Moderna tehnologija im omogućuje rad na različitim mjestima.

r19.exp: 'Upsides to the location independence (19)____.' → A: that they have with their peers. Prednosti slobode lokacije koje imaju u usporedbi s drugima.

r20.exp: 'Top three reasons (20)____.' → D: why they would choose such a lifestyle. Razlozi zašto odabiru nomadski život.

r21.exp: 'We ARE USED TO TAKING our smart phones everywhere' = navikli smo uzimati mobitele svugdje (sadašnja navika). 'Be used to + gerund'.

r22.exp: 'Open your mind TO the splash of water' — fiksni prijedlog: open one's mind to something (biti otvoren za nešto).

r23.exp: 'This COULD become dangerous' = moglo bi postati opasno. 'Could' za mogućnost/potencijalnu opasnost.

r24.exp: 'Even if IT IS a cloudy day' — realna uvjetna surečenica: even if + present simple (stvarna mogućnost).

r25.exp: 'Rays bounce OFF the water's surface' — frazalni glagol: bounce off = odbiti se od. Sunčeve zrake se odbijaju od površine vode.

r26.exp: 'There is no sight LIKE a happy child cuddling a wallaby' — 'like' = poput, kao (usporedba). 'No sight like' = nema ničega sličnog.

r27.exp: 'Gets light AT six o'clock' — prijedlog 'at' za točno vrijeme.

r28.exp: 'It HASN'T rained for several weeks' — present perfect negacija za stanje koje traje do sada: hasn't + past participle.

r29.exp: 'Done by mid-afternoon, WHICH is great' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za ne-restriktivnu surečenicu (uz zarez, odnosi se na cijelu prethodnu rečenicu).

r30.exp: 'Super-cautious ABOUT getting sunburnt' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: cautious about (oprezan u pogledu nečega).

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) zašto si odlučio/la naučiti kuhati, (2) koji dio tečaja ti se svidio i zašto, (3) bi li preporučio/la tečaj i zašto. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi).
